If music is his medium, sneakers are his fixation. In the second episode of Obsessions, creative powerhouse RITVIZ unveils his coveted collection of over 23+ sneakers; putting a lifetime of curation on display.

"a tribute to the 4-games ‘hide & seek’ streak a 5 year old Kapil Dev achieved in the summer of ‘64"

"inspired by the time a 23 year old Kapil Dev resumed his disco dancing lessons"

"inspired by the time Kapil Dev accidentally booked tickets to Hawaii instead of Raipur"

snippet.description:
Ever noticed something unusual about alcohol and tobacco ads? They’re telling us they’re an alcohol or tobacco brand without really telling us they’re an alcohol or tobacco brand.
